blocks.text: Start by recording the failure and recent changes. If there are I/O errors or suspected storage damage, reduce writes and preserve important data before attempting repair. Recovery actions need the correct device, filesystem and encryption context.

Computer Management → System & Recovery → Recovery & Repair contains reviewed recovery actions. Read confirmations carefully. They may change storage, boot or security state; opening Help never performs them.

items: What failed: login, application, mount, update or boot.
The time and the relevant sanitized error.
Whether data is still readable and whether an independent backup is available.
The selected storage profile, when known.

blocks.text: Do not guess block-device names, run mkfs, change partitions, clear TPM keys or rewrite boot entries as a generic fix. A failed command does not prove rollback; retain any recovery path reported by the owning tool.
